companies.name: Klaviyo
companies.sub: マーケティングソフト

relations.text: Shopifyの投資先としてKlaviyoのSeries B普通株の購入オプションを保有し、その価値が2025年12月31日時点で7500万ドルである
relations.text_en: Shopify holds an option to purchase Series B common shares in Klaviyo, representing $75 million of its investments as of December 31, 2025

source.label: Shopify 10-K
source.quote: Additionally, Shopify evaluates its investments to determine if the investment should be accounted for as an equity method investment based upon equity ownership, significant influence and ongoing involvement in the investee.

relations.text: Klaviyoは、Shopifyに普通株を発行・売却し、2030年7月28日までShopifyが追加購入できるオプションを付けた
relations.text_en: Klaviyo issued and sold common stock to Shopify with an option to purchase additional shares until July 28, 2030

source.label: Klaviyo 10-K
source.quote: Under the stock purchase agreement, we issued and sold shares of common stock to Shopify and provided an investment option which allows Shopify to purchase additional shares of common stock at a fixed price, exercisable at any time at Shopify’s option until July 28, 2030.

relations.text: KlaviyoはShopifyと連携しており、その終了や劣化が顧客喪失につながり得ると述べている
relations.text_en: Klaviyo says termination or degradation of its integration with Shopify could cause it to lose customers

source.label: Klaviyo 10-K
source.quote: However, the termination or degradation of our integration with Shopify could cause us to lose customers if these customers do not transition to a new eCommerce platform, or if they transition to a platform that does not integrate with our platform.

relations.text: PayPalとの契約は初期期間後、12か月ごとに自動更新される
relations.text_en: The PayPal agreement automatically renews every 12 months after its initial term

source.label: Shopify 10-K
source.quote: The PayPal agreement, following its initial term, automatically renews every 12 months, unless either party terminates the agreement earlier.

relations.text: Microsoft Copilotとの連携を更新し、新しい組み込み型チェックアウトを導入する
relations.text_en: Shopify is updating its Microsoft Copilot integration with a new embedded checkout experience

source.label: Shopify — agentic commerce / UCP, January 11, 2026
source.quote: We are also releasing an update to our Microsoft Copilot integration with a new embedded checkout experience.

relations.text: Shopifyの加盟店がCopilot Checkoutで販売できるようにする
relations.text_en: The update lets Shopify merchants sell through Copilot Checkout

source.label: Shopify — agentic commerce / UCP, January 11, 2026
source.quote: We're also rolling out an update to our Microsoft integration, enabling Shopify merchants to sell through Copilot Checkout, a new embedded checkout that allows users to shop directly in Copilot.

relations.text: Rokuは、Shopifyなどと提携したアクション広告を展開していると述べている
relations.text_en: Roku says many of its action ads are in partnership with companies such as Shopify

source.label: Roku 10-K
source.quote: Many of our action ads are in partnership with companies such as Walmart, Shopify, and Instacart that connect their products with viewers and provide enhanced targeting and closed-loop measurement.
source.note: Rokuの文書による記載です。

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
